redteam.case_for_completing_119_first:
Strict mode is the product. The Oracle's first line, "If it compiles, it proves" (oracle-main.md L1), and the owner's direction that GNATprove "should be nothing more than a safety check with any failure a bug report" (unbounded-programs.md L43-45) are delivered above 4,096 bytes only by #119's rule plus #90/#91. Under the draft every program larger than today's bound is loose: it compiles only if its own prover run finishes (assurance-modes-draft.md L19-23), so Silver regresses to "no worse than GNATprove" for all practical programs. The scaling record caps what loose mode can deliver: the dense 8-KB probe stopped at a 14-GiB guard, dense 16 KB extrapolates to ~90 GiB, and runs reached only 32.5 KB mixed / 16.3 KB straight-line (unbounded-programs.md L563-565, L641-642; assurance-modes-draft.md L67). Dense programs beyond that are inadmissible in loose mode and admissible only by construction, which is #119's route.

The owner already decided this order. On 2026-10-19 the owner adopted loose mode "in principle" but said "We will pause build until 119 completes in any case due to token restrictions" (assurance-modes-branch.diff L226-230); the branch roadmap records "Build stays paused until #119 completes" (L337-338); the session-memory entry lists "resuming #119" and "starting #88-#94" as not authorized (L242-243). The issue body says the owner-directed continuation "supersedes using the earlier research-stop alternative" and that "a completed component ... does not complete the full derivation or unlock production" (issue-119-body.md L73). The R47 reviewed stop (comment 76, 18:55Z) was answered "Please continue" within 29 minutes (comment 77, 19:24Z; branch diff L156-157), and the owner resumed #119 after every one of six pauses (comments 54, 59, 63, 77, 79, 82). The draft's "freeze and defer" is that stop under another name.

The crude envelope is not a shortcut. Its four hard rows each cite "#119" (assurance-modes-draft.md L88-91); the frontend rows are exactly the open #201 work ("general input-low nested providers and later native phases remain open", r92-README.md L29-30, L101-102); the Why-node row has "detection on overflow unresolved"; the same unestablished SPARK snapshot identity premise applies (retained-tool-capacity.md L2339-2352). No record supports "ten rounds": telemetry has been unavailable since R60 (r92-README.md L90-92), #153 ran from creation 2026-10-20T07:10Z to technical completion at R78 (~53 rounds; milestone5-issues.txt, issue-153.md L2), and the R47 call for "a bounded hypothesis and an explicit checkpoint" (retained-tool-capacity-stop.md L153-155) was followed by 45 rounds.

Finishing now preserves reuse: #88's uncapped configuration, #89's route and #93's runtime regeneration each invalidate configuration-bound closures (retained-tool-capacity.md L1918-1919; issue-93.md L15; retained-main-why-storage.md L323-327). Pausing strands four unreviewed packets (active-119-checkpoint.md L21-39), 73 open findings (open-finding-numbers.txt) and 68 "Fixes" keyed to an unmerged PR (MATERIALS.md L12). The remaining work is enumerable: three children with concrete lists (retained-general-native-capacity.md L444-448; retained-main-why-storage.md L342-356; r92-README.md L68-70, L101-105), nine technically complete (MATERIALS.md L13).

silent_limits.soundness_caveats: True only while the String value cap stays. A left-associative chain of n static leaves with total length L can materialize up to n intermediates summing <= n*L characters; with L <= 4,096 and 1-byte names, ~1,000+ characters per source byte worst case (my arithmetic), so 2^31 is reached near ~2 MB of maximally dense folding source. The draft's loose table raises the String value bound to 'host-limited, below the character ceiling'; then the charge scales with V and a per-byte constant is implausible - the sound cheap alternative is a source-computed sum of folded intermediate lengths. The draft's 'concatenation expansion bounded by output length' covers only the final value, which the records explicitly warn against (L2305).

envelope.is_it_really_bounded: Smaller in degree, not in kind. Real reductions: only silent rows need bounds; current grammar only (no generics or user subprograms; unrolling off per language-main.md L318 and scope L362); worst-case constants instead of per-construct vectors; no source-sensitive decidability/optimality comparison; Lean/native correspondence deferred to #90/#91. The accepted components do supply usable constants for the GNAT-side rows (two scans per literal/identifier, node layout and constructor vectors for five samples, digit bounds, source-position recurrence with a conditional fixed closure: contract L1887-1931). Three things make it a partial re-run of #119: (1) the detected/silent split the draft rests on is itself unestablished - table.adb silence appears only in the draft (not found elsewhere; scope L108-109 ties table-growth behaviour to compiler build switches), gnat2why node-table detection and snapshot identity are open (contract L2329-2340), the Image counter and report writer are projections (scope L486-499), and GCC/gas/ld/GNATCOLL 32-bit quantities (contract L1933; #186) are not classified at all; doing that classification at #119's inventory standard is the same enumeration work that consumed R29-R92. (2) A per-byte constant is sound only while the 4,096 String value and exponent caps stay; the draft's loose table raises both (V host-limited; exponent 799,999 at ~332 KB Uint each), which turns the envelope into a source-computed sum (still cheap) and reintroduces the Udigits pool the draft omits. (3) The project's own standard (every packet independently reviewed; repairs #207/#209/#211/#215/#218/#219 inside R83-R92) means even narrow 'interface' children took 2-3 rounds plus review (#178, #185, #186, #193, #194, #206 per gh/issues headers), while broad ones overran (#153 R25->R78; #201 open after ~10 rounds). Verdict: bounded only if the owner explicitly adopts premises in place of inventories - treat table.adb, Udigits, String_Chars and Why_Node_Id as hard without proving silence; enumerate or trust-exclude OCaml/GCC 32-bit quantities by a stated premise; keep the V and exponent caps in loose mode until the computed-sum envelope exists; take constants from the contract summaries. Without those premises it is #119 step 3 ('useful-domain comparison against a justified uniform envelope', ledger L2049-2067; contract L2390-2425) under another name.
envelope.what_the_envelope_would_allow: Illustrative only, from recorded ceilings and worst-case per-byte charges at the current 4,096 value/exponent caps (my arithmetic unless cited): source positions ~2 GB minus the fixed closure (contract L1887-1920); GNAT names/descriptors 100M -> >=200 MB; nodes 2x10^9 at tens of nodes per byte -> tens of MB; Why literal nodes 2^30 at c*27 nodes per byte for maximal fold chains -> ~5-10 MB (plain literal text ~200-350 MB); static string characters 2^31 at ~1,000 characters per byte for maximal fold chains -> ~2 MB (plain text >1 GB); Image counter if treated hard -> 41-321 MB (scope L488-490); GNATprove report writer if silent -> ~587 KB under the documented envelope (scope Research-evidence table). So a conservative envelope with caps retained admits on the order of 10^5-10^6 bytes (hundreds of KB to a few MB) - roughly 100-1,000x today's 4,096 - for sparse/structured source. Detected limits bind earlier in practice: dense 8 KB already exceeded a 14 GiB prover guard (scope Research evidence; draft loose table), and the literal-output relocation boundary is 30,653 one-byte calls (ledger L869), about 0.6-0.8 MB of such source. All current samples (<1 KB per MATERIALS) are far inside any of these.
detected_vs_silent_gaps: Image occurrence counter (2^31-1): draft row says 'reported as inconclusive, naming the limit' (detected), but the scope's 6.685-52.266 identifiers per source byte are 'illustrative extrapolations from two shapes', 'encoding width/growth may change the projection; memory need not exhaust first', and 'widening the adapter alone does not widen the producer' (unbounded-programs.md L486-493); detection rests on Silver's own projected count, the producer's behaviour at the counter is not recorded.

Report writer ~2 GiB Natural-indexed limit: draft puts it among raisable numbers as 'inconclusive'; scope says it 'remains to be verified from producer source in #89, with its role classified by #119/#91' (L494-499) and the documented report envelope 'reaches Natural'Last near 587 KB' (Research-evidence table). If silent it is the first binding hard limit for dense source.

GNAT table identifiers: draft classifies table.adb overflow as silent; no record in the materials establishes silent vs detected (grep for table.adb/does not check overflow: found only in assurance-modes-draft.md L89); scope L108-109 says compiler build switches govern the allocation-growth behaviour. Conservative to keep hard, but the classification is unresolved.

GNATprove literal producer: the draft itself says 'detection on overflow unresolved; treated as hard'; additionally the inspected SPARK snapshot's identity as the installed archive is 'not established' (contract L2337-2340), so even the 2^30 figure is a snapshot fact.

Link reach: draft says ld reports relocation overflow (detected); the ledger's 30,653/30,654 boundary is 'the adjacent sufficient-rule boundary ... not an observed tool cutoff' (ledger L869) - no observed ld failure is recorded.

Z3 --steps above 5,368,146 'exceeds Z3's 32-bit resource limit and wraps' (scope L380-381): a silent wrap avoided only by the zero-steps configuration premise; the draft's loose prover row carries it as a rule, not a detected failure.

Unclassified 32-bit quantities outside the draft's table: GCC 'RTL offsets within the 32-bit alignment-mask region', 'conditional signed32 envelope 1,745,421,669' (contract L1933, L2132), ELF/BFD name offsets, GNATCOLL JSON 'intermediate unsigned32 multiplication and rounding' (gh/issues/issue-186.md); Why3 OCaml counters (one 'can wrap with defined OCaml semantics without affecting behavior', contract L1481; 'native Why3 counter/storage lifetimes' open, L1932). The draft neither lists nor classifies these; the envelope package must classify or trust-exclude them by stated premise.
caveats: The five charge-component files (retained-value-capacity, retained-table-capacity, retained-frontend-entities, retained-main-semantics, retained-native-expansion, retained-producer-strings) are not in the materials; their charges are cited only as summarized in the contract's component table (L1928-1932). Per-byte figures labelled 'my arithmetic' combine recorded ceilings with worst-case shapes under the current grammar (1-byte names, 64-leaf left-associative chains, 4,096-byte values); they are not recorded bounds and would need the fold materialization inventory to be sound.

Rounds estimate basis: narrow children closed in 2-3 rounds plus review (#178 R75-R77, #185/#186 R79, #193 R81, #194 R82, #206 R84 per gh/issues headers and MATERIALS context facts); broad children overran (#153 created 2026-10-20, technically complete R78; #201/#202/#212 open after ~8-10 rounds with long remaining lists in r92-README '## Continuation'). The envelope spans four or five limits across two frontend processes plus a detection classification that no round has yet attempted, hence 8 (premise-based) to 30 (inventory standard retained). Harness goal counters give ~1.4-1.5M tokens per round for R25-R58 (MATERIALS Addendum), so 8-30 rounds is roughly 11M-45M harness tokens including subthreads and input, not isolated worker cost; R60-R92 have no counters.

The envelope's soundness depends on loose mode retaining --no-loop-unrolling (language-main.md L318; scope L362) and, until a computed-sum envelope exists, the 4,096 String value and exponent caps; the draft's loose table raises both, which contradicts a per-byte constant.
Both GNAT compilation and the gnat2why embedded frontend must be charged as separate processes (contract '## Phase and cost model'); the draft's rows do not say which process each ceiling applies to.

The production route is GPRbuild over seven units, not the researched two-unit bundle (stop report '## Results preserved'); fixed-closure constants derived on the researched route are conditional on #89 adopting it or rederiving.
